objective: Discover recurring workflow problems faced by small service businesses. Compare opportunities before selecting one; do not assume an invoicing product.
acceptance_criteria: Compare at least three observed customer problems using dated, attributable sources
Separate observations, inferences and assumptions; disclose absent customer validation
Recommend one bounded validation experiment with costs, risks, success metrics and stop criteria

context.approval_boundary: Product development requires separate founder investment approval
context.evidence_requirement: No fabricated interviews, demand, revenue or market size
